label: sequences starting with r: late original tokens and the first copy step after r
explanation: Weak, sparse feature (max 0.25) tied to sequences whose first original token is r (first_tok=r: 85% of activation mass, 25.7x lift). It fires at two points. (1) Late in the original phase (t>=4, peak around t=5), often on r/k/0/s/g/a/z/1 inputs, frequently after v/b/h/m. (2) The step after <DEL>, when the copied r is fed back as input and the model outputs the second token (recall_idx=1; 41% of mass). It never fires at t<3 or on later copy steps (recall_idx>=2), and almost never on the <DEL> step. Even within r-first sequences only about 0.6% fire, so precision is low. The second-token and input-token lists in the predicate are fitted (second token t/g/2/u etc. raises the rate), and they still leave most r-first steps inactive. The simpler first_tok==r & ((phase 0 & t>=4) | recall_idx==1) gets 84% mass recall but 2% precision. Magnitude is somewhat higher at recall_idx=1 and when the second token is t, but no clean magnitude driver was found.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=r (+6.29), orig1=t (+3.74), orig0=t (+3.69), orig1=r (+3.32), orig1=u (+3.09), orig0=p (+2.98). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-5.31), orig_idx=-1 (-3.94), t=3 (-2.74), prev_tok=g (-2.31).
